form.name: Name
form.instructionsPlaceholder: Define this Bot's responsibilities, coding conventions, and communication style…
form.projectHelp: Each Bot operates inside one bound project. Write tasks run in isolated Git worktrees.
form.projectBusyHint: Finish or cancel active tasks before switching the bound project.
form.modelsHelp: Configure Router (chat & orchestration) and Worker (coding & tools) independently, or use the same model for both.
form.routerRoleDesc: Handles the permanent chat, trigger batching, and Worker orchestration.
form.workerRoleDesc: Executes isolated code edits, shell commands, and analysis inside the bound project.
form.archiveHelp: Archived Bots stop accepting messages while preserving history and worktrees.
form.deleteHelp: Permanently remove this Bot, its chat history, and task records.
form.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the Bot and its conversation history. This action cannot be undone.
form.unmergedWarning: This Bot still has {{count}} unmerged Git worktree(s). You can inspect and merge them first, or force clean them and delete the Bot.
